pure-joy-heart-family-matching-hoodies.print_sentence: A red heart sits above the words Pure joy in dark script on the cream front of each hoodie, with brick-red raglan sleeves and a brick-red hood.
pure-joy-heart-family-matching-hoodies.feature_text: The same heart and script print runs from the kids' sizes to adult 4XL, so the whole family matches in fall photos.
